title: Prior-only regime and residual flow prototype
objective: Test whether the current direction and acceleration of the 27-feature state field can help select which prior-only feature-ranking rule to use next, rather than selecting a rule only from its global or recent historical success.

scope.selector_candidates: 27 existing single-feature ranking strategies; Q80-Q88 multi-feature formula families are not yet included in this prototype.

method.feature_state: For every target, compute the registered 27 per-number features from the strict prefix before that target; standardize each feature across numbers 1..40; rank the five actual numbers under each feature.
method.level_state: For each feature, record the mean standardized score of its five highest-ranked numbers and the contemporaneous cross-feature correlation summaries.
method.flow_state: First differences and second differences of the 27 level descriptors, plus changes in cross-feature correlation summaries, velocity magnitude, acceleration magnitude, divergence and turning cosine.
method.level_knn: Select the feature with the best weighted mean actual-number rank among the 25 nearest prior state-level observations.
method.flow_only_knn: Select the feature using only velocity, acceleration and correlation-change descriptors among the 25 nearest prior flow states.
method.hybrid_knn: Select using both level and flow descriptors.
method.recency_baseline: Select the feature with the best mean actual-number rank over the preceding 100 targets.
method.equal_weight_baseline: Rank numbers by the mean standardized score across all 27 features.
method.fixed_baseline: Select the best single feature over discovery only, then freeze it for validation and blind OOS.

knn_parameters.distance: Euclidean after scaling each state dimension by the standard deviation of the available prior history
knn_parameters.selection_objective: minimize predicted mean rank of actual numbers

method.regime_thresholds: Expansion/contraction/stable/turbulent cutpoints are estimated from discovery states only and then held fixed.
method.evaluation: All model comparisons use the same target dates from scored-target index 100 onward. At target t, state features use draws strictly before t and KNN/recency selection uses outcomes only from targets earlier than t.

metric_definitions.top5_top10_top20: Mean fraction of the five actual numbers ranked within the corresponding Top-k; not the probability of a 5/5 quintet.
metric_definitions.mean_rank: Mean rank of the five actual numbers; lower is better.
metric_definitions.best_feature_match: Fraction of targets where the selected feature equals the retrospective best feature for that target; diagnostic only.
metric_definitions.hindsight_regret: Selected feature mean rank minus the retrospective best feature mean rank; diagnostic only.

interpretation: The flow-only selector is the most stable of the adaptive variants across discovery, validation and blind OOS on mean-rank and Top10/Top20 metrics.
On blind OOS, flow-only mean rank is 20.35 versus 20.5 uniform; Top10 is 25.40% versus 25.0%; Top20 is 51.01% versus 50.0%; Top5 is 12.24%, below the 12.5% uniform reference.
The flow-only versus level-only paired bootstrap intervals include zero; this is a weak exploratory signal, not validated predictive advantage.
Adding current levels to flow in this prototype degraded blind-OOS performance; this suggests testing directional-change descriptors separately rather than assuming more inputs are better.

The retrospective best-feature oracle reaches mean rank near 12 but is not an attainable ex-ante model. The flow selector matches that hindsight winner on only about 5.1% of blind-OOS targets, showing a large remaining selection gap.
The expansion regime has worse equal-weight rank performance than the transition regime in this sample, but this is descriptive and requires independent prospective/chronological confirmation.
limitations: This is a JavaScript prototype calculation, not yet a committed reproducible Python runner or a full Q84 acceptance artifact set.
Only the 27 registered single-feature strategies are included in the selector; multi-feature Q80-Q88 formulas and conditional grammars remain to be integrated.
The KNN settings were fixed for this prototype and have not undergone a preregistered hyperparameter sensitivity grid.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory; no global family-wise correction has been applied across all variants and endpoints.
The flow descriptors are empirical state summaries inspired by fluid dynamics, not a claim that the lottery mechanism is a physical fluid or that the observed states have causal meaning.
The current archive includes 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09, but the persisted Q80-Q88 grammar outputs still need refresh against this new cutoff.
